items.text: It measures test-ready skill, not job offers.

supporting: India Skills Report 2026 put B.E. and B.Tech employability at 70.15 percent, down from 71.5 percent a year earlier. Computer science scored 80 and IT 78. It measures test-ready skill, not job offers.
Staffing firm Xpheno counted about 10,000 such openings, down 44 percent from a year earlier. TCS ended FY26 with 23,460 fewer employees than the year before.
